title: Wren · all ten at 3×
caption: Ten brand-new gnome designs beside the CC0 pawn and knight. Judge: which two or three are Wren?

title: Wren · at game size
caption: All ten at 1× on the grass beside the pack. Judge: does each read as a gnome, and does any stand out as not Pixel Frog?

title: 1. Toadstool Forager
caption: Gathers in the mushroom hollows: a round jade toadstool for a hat, spotted with glowing spores, a basket of finds held low at her side. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it a gnome at 1×?

title: 1. Toadstool Forager · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say quiet, a little ominous?

title: 8. Twig-crown Druid · own body, motion

title: 2. Bell-jar Keeper · own body, motion

title: 9. Flowerpot Potter · shoulders and nose

title: 9. Flowerpot Potter · the nose flops
